about.body: The AJ300D is Land Rover's 3.0-litre inline-six diesel engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced in 2019. It's a 6-cylinder diesel used across five current Land Rover model lines — the Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Range Rover Velar — primarily in mild-hybrid (MHEV) form. We rebuild AJ300D engines across all five applications, with the same standard component replacement scope regardless of which model it's fitted to. Rebuilds start from £2,800.

byModel.body: Across the Defender (L663), the AJ300D appears as the D200, D250, D300 and D350 variants from 2020 onwards. The Discovery (L462) uses the same engine in D250, D300 and D350 form from 2020. The current Range Rover (L460) and Range Rover Sport (L461) both use the AJ300D in D250, D300 and D350 specifications from 2022. The Range Rover Velar (L560) uses the AJ300D in D200, D250 and D300 from 2019.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ300D spans five different models across multiple generations — all in mild-hybrid (48V) form — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. An AJ300D from a Velar isn't a drop-in match for an AJ300D from a Range Rover, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and 48V system integration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
